'''April 2001 Greeley tournament''' was a Star Wars CCG local tournament held in Digital Dungeon, Greely, Colorado on 20 April 2001. [[Jason Keen]] won it. It is known from Jason Keen's tournament report.<ref name="tr-d2227">[https://www.stephenskilton.com/decktech_archives/reports/2001-05-03-greely-co-4-20-01-a-new-secret-based2227/ greely-co-4-20-01-a-new-secret-base], DeckTech (Jason "Qui" Keen, 3 May 2001). Preservation copy: [https://stevetotheizz0.github.io/decktech_archives/reports/2001-05-03-greely-co-4-20-01-a-new-secret-based2227/ GitHub Pages].</ref>

* '''Date:''' 20 April 2001
* '''Site:''' Digital Dungeon, Greely, Colorado
* '''Format:''' [[Premiere - Reflections II]]
* '''Players:''' 10
* '''Winner:''' [[Jason Keen]]
